evidence: The reactant exposure sequence for each cycle was as follows: (1) expose TMA, (2) TMA reaction time, (3) pump out excess TMA and reaction products, (4) dose N2, (5) pump out N2, (6) expose H2O, (7) H2O reaction time, (8) pump out excess H2O and reaction products, (9) dose N2, and (10) pump out N2. The reaction times were 60 s. The pump out times for the precursors were also 60 s. The pump out time for the N2 was 120 s. Each reactant exposure was about 5 s in length. These steps were repeated in an ABAB… reaction sequence to deposit Al2O3. Each reaction cycle was 6 min in duration.
